title: Market, Limit, Stop: Order Types in 3 Minutes #Shorts
description:
Compare market, limit, post-only, stop, IOC and FOK orders on one illustrative order book. A stop trigger at 99 can lead to a sale below 99 or no fill, depending on the order. Venue rules and liquidity vary.
